CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.

5. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Football.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   C. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

7. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

11. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

12. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
